mapper.sql: product.product_id,product.category_id,product.product_name,product.subtitle,product.main_image,product.images_json,product.detail_html,product.product_params_json,MIN(sku.sale_price) price_cent,MIN(sku.market_price) market_price_cent,CASE WHEN MAX(sku.available_stock) > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END sold_out
mapper.select: SELECT banner_id,title,image_url,jump_type,target_value FROM mall_banner WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0' AND begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY sort_num,banner_id
SELECT category_id,parent_id,category_name FROM mall_category WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0' ORDER BY sort_num,category_id

SELECT FROM mall_product product INNER JOIN mall_category category ON category.category_id=product.category_id AND category.del_flag='0' AND category.status='0' INNER JOIN mall_product_sku sku ON sku.product_id=product.product_id AND sku.del_flag='0' AND sku.status='0' WHERE product.del_flag='0' AND product.status='1' AND (product.category_id=#{categoryId} OR category.parent_id=#{categoryId}) AND (product.product_name LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%') OR product.subtitle LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%') OR category.category_name LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY product.product_id,product.category_id,product.product_name,product.subtitle,product.main_image,product.images_json,product.detail_html,product.product_params_json ORDER BY product.product_id DESC

SELECT FROM mall_product product INNER JOIN mall_category category ON category.category_id=product.category_id AND category.del_flag='0' AND category.status='0' INNER JOIN mall_product_sku sku ON sku.product_id=product.product_id AND sku.del_flag='0' AND sku.status='0' WHERE product.product_id=#{productId} AND product.del_flag='0' AND product.status='1' GROUP BY product.product_id,product.category_id,product.product_name,product.subtitle,product.main_image,product.images_json,product.detail_html,product.product_params_json

SELECT sku_id,sku_name,spec_values_json,image_url,sale_price price_cent,market_price market_price_cent,available_stock,CASE WHEN available_stock > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END sold_out FROM mall_product_sku WHERE product_id=#{productId} AND del_flag='0' AND status='0' ORDER BY sku_id

SELECT sku.sku_id,product.product_id,product.product_name,sku.sku_name,sku.spec_values_json,COALESCE(sku.image_url,product.main_image) image_url,sku.sale_price price_cent,sku.market_price market_price_cent,sku.available_stock,CASE WHEN product.status='1' AND product.del_flag='0' AND category.status='0' AND category.del_flag='0' AND sku.status='0' AND sku.del_flag='0' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END available,CASE WHEN product.status!='1' OR product.del_flag!='0' OR category.status!='0' OR category.del_flag!='0' OR sku.status!='0' OR sku.del_flag!='0' THEN '商品已失效' ELSE NULL END unavailable_reason,CASE WHEN sku.available_stock > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END sold_out FROM mall_product_sku sku INNER JOIN mall_product product ON product.product_id=sku.product_id INNER JOIN mall_category category ON category.category_id=product.category_id WHERE sku.sku_id IN #{skuId}
